description: Handoff from review to finalize — lives at .envoy/review/handoff-to-finalize.json.

layers.$comment: requiredItemNames is an ENVOY EXTENSION, not a JSON Schema keyword: it asserts that an array of {name,...} objects contains an item for each listed name (see lib/validate-schema.js). Generic JSON Schema validators ignore it. Enforcement tier is the consumer's choice — skills/finalize/preflight.js degrades a missing "tests" entry to a warning so handoffs written before this requirement existed still finalize.
